# SUCSData.txt - Base SUCS codepoint inventory (starter)
# Columns: <codepoint>;<name>;<type>
#   type 0 = printable native allocation (cursor advances)
#   type 1 = control / machine instruction (cursor does NOT advance)
# Ranges follow the architecture memory:
#   Unicode Bridge  0x00000000-0x0010FFFF  (1:1 with Unicode, type 0)
#   SCP             0x00110000-0x0011FFFF  (control plane, type 1)
#   Native          0x00120000-0x7FFFFFFF  (native allocations)
#   Traps           0x7FFFFFF0-0x7FFFFFFE  (type 1)
#   Sentinel        0x7FFFFFFF             (SUCS_CP_SENTINEL, not an allocation)
00000000-0010FFFF;UNICODE BRIDGE;0
00110000-0011FFFF;SUPERUNICODE CONTROL PLANE;1
0011A000-0011A7FF;BANCODE BLOCK (B+);1
0011A800-0011ABFF;WARNCODE BLOCK (W+);1
0011AC00-0011ADFF;COMCODE BLOCK (C+);1
0011AE00-0011AEFF;SOFTCODE BLOCK (S+);1
00120000-7FFFFFFF;NATIVE ALLOCATION SPACE;0
7FFFFFF0-7FFFFFFE;TRAP MACHINE INSTRUCTIONS;1
